name: isotox-penta
comment: AL's WORKED EXAMPLE, as its own palette (2026-08-25). U30 is 5/2.3.5/2.3.5/2.3; its isotoxal analogue needs only the triangle, the pentagon and the pentagram OUTLINE 5*12 (point 36, dent 252). Three tiles instead of nine, which is the star-ico-d / star-hept-pyr pattern: a targeted palette is how this engine answers a specific question. The full nine-tile isotox-mixed alphabet is 207,658 configs against 586 at positive-defect and its solver wrote 30 GB in ten minutes — a mixed closure on a D=120 grid is not something to run blind. ⚑ MIXED and not positive-defect, because a 252-degree dent forces its vertex past 504 degrees and so is always a SADDLE; that is about the closure and not about a circumsphere.
